answer: To prevent identity cloning, recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments are bound to a verifiable delay function with parameter delta. This system routes state transitions through a cryptographic prism, using a jade root of trust to secure epoch-based updates across decentralized agents. Coupling this with a ten-unit staking collateral and absolute slashing penalties forces a negative expected attack utility, securing a robust Nash equilibrium where identity spoofing is computationally infeasible.
